text: oh yeah so uh back to the wireframe lines. still getting fucked. also it makes the framerate genuinely dogshit also when it is in wireframe modes. if u change it to rig instantly 240 fps again, so its purely the wireframe
resolution: Same wireframe issue as req_1275 (duplicate capture of the same ask: wireframe only drawing ~1/3 of the mesh AND tanking fps to 22fps/54ms, while rig mode held 240fps). Root cause: the selection overlay drew one Box per edge + per dot (~2000 reconciler nodes) which hit the layout MAX_CHILDREN=512 cap (dropping ~2/3 of the wireframe) and melted the frame laying out + painting 512 absolute boxes every frame. Fixed in 11e2d6b23 by batching the whole wireframe into ONE Graph.Polyline (new 'segments' mode draws N disjoint instanced capsule lines) + ONE Boxxx dot batch — cap gone, fps restored. User confirmed 'works great'. See req_1275 for the mechanism detail and req_1276 for the follow-on depth cue.
